[JOINT REPORT(S)]
BPW-2026-0464
BOE + BOS
CD 11
CONSTRUCTION BUDGET AND AWARD – VENICE PUMPING PLANT (VPP) 646 VALVE REPLACEMENT PROJECT
Recommending the Board:
AUTHORIZE a construction budget of $4,972,558.50 including contingency for the VPP 646 Valve Replacement Project;
AUTHORIZE the City Engineer to award this project to the lowest, responsive, and responsible bidder, MNR Construction, Inc., in compliance with established procedures of the On-Call Emergency Sewer and Storm Drain Repairs Contract; and
AUTHORIZE the City Engineer to issue construction orders, revised construction orders, and change orders up to the authorized construction budget for this project to MNR Construction, Inc.
(W.O.: SZC14473, C-141947)
